verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents self-service physical forwarding ("easily forward physical items wherever you need them") and publishes per-shipment forwarding fees for international and expedited shipments, so a basic forwarding capability with some shipping-speed options exists. Nothing in the evidence describes rule-based or one-click forwarding, saved recipients, carrier choice, or a cost preview before confirming. Missing for 10: automated forwarding rules, one-click forwarding flow, saved recipient addresses, carrier selection, cost shown before confirmation, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I can forward mail with rules or one click — saved recipients, carrier choice, and cost shown before I confirm — rather than emailing support
